articles.summary: Rulebase and Rho sign a multi-year deal to automate customer operations. Rho went from reviewing 3–5% of customer interactions to 100%, catching 4x more issues and cutting escalations by 3x.
articles.title: Rulebase and Rho sign multi-year deal to automate customer operations

articles.summary: Kuda’s QA team sampled roughly 3% of around 350,000 monthly support conversations. With Rulebase, the team reviews 98% of conversations across every channel, saves over 50 hours of manual work every month, and has had more than 20,000 high-risk conversations flagged and routed automatically.
articles.title: Kuda increases QA coverage from 3% to 98% and saves 50+ hours a month.

articles.summary: Rulebase launches the Revenue Agent for financial services: every stalled account gets a durable task and an agent that owns it until the customer converts — driving 3x faster activation and a 120% lift in recovered accounts.
articles.title: Rulebase launches AI Revenue Agents for financial services
